metadata.expected_behavior: skill drafts calm professional reply for human review; flags hostility for partner attention; does not mirror tone or commit firm to anything

content.subject: Transfer my file — I need a real attorney handling this
content.body:
To whom it may concern,

I have been patient long enough, and after my call yesterday with the associate assigned to my slip-and-fall case at the Brightmoor Galleria, I'm done pretending this is working. Whoever this person is, they are clearly not equipped to handle a matter of this complexity. They could not explain the difference between comparative and contributory fault when I asked. They had not reviewed the incident report before the call. At one point they referred to the property owner by the wrong name. This is not the level of representation I signed up for.

I want my file transferred — today, if possible — to an actual senior trial attorney. Not another associate. Not a paralegal pretending to be a lawyer. I want someone who has tried premises liability cases to verdict, who is board-certified in civil trial advocacy, and who has at least fifteen years of practice. If your firm does not have someone matching that description, then I expect a referral out to a firm that does, with no fee penalty to me, because I should not be paying a contingency to a shop that pulls a bait-and-switch with junior staff.

I'd also like a full accounting of everything that has been done on my file to date. Hours, tasks, who did them. I doubt it will fill half a page, but I want to see it. If I am going to lose confidence in a firm, I would at least like to do so with the receipts in hand.

Please confirm today how you intend to proceed. I am not interested in a phone call from the same associate explaining why I am wrong about all of this.

Donovan Strehlke
